| Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
